request.text:
A: <brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: idle.> Blood on the planks and carts going over them. Trade's never been squeamish.
<long pause>
A: <brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: happy.> The clan wants salt, of all things. I never thought I'd have goblin custom.
<long pause>
A: <brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: idle.> People are buying blankets. Only blankets. Somebody knows something about this cold.
<long pause>
A: <brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: idle.> Prices are what they are. Don't blame the merchant for the weather.
<long pause>
A: <brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: happy.> Everything here is honest goods. Mostly honest. Ask me about the wool.
<long pause>
A: <brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: surprised.> Shards for next to nothing. Next to nothing! Ash Market's practically giving them away. Makes me nervous.
<long pause>
B: <restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice Mood: sad.> We took the bridge back. The captain hasn't said a word since. Neither have I.
<long pause>
B: <restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice Mood: idle.> Captain made peace with them. Some of the lads don't like it. I like breathing.
<long pause>
B: <restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice Mood: idle.> Orders are to watch the docks now. Watch them for what, nobody says.
<long pause>
B: <restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice Mood: idle.> Long shift, cold boots. Same as every week.
<long pause>
B: <restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice Mood: sad.> Pier duty. Stand by the river, don't touch the glow. Coldest posting in the Vale.
